name: Wood
description: Heavy hardwood, still smelling of resin and rain.

name: Stick
description: A dry branch, light enough to carry a dozen.

name: Bamboo
description: A hollow green stalk, strong and straight.

name: Stone
description: A river-worn rock that fits the palm.

name: Flint
description: A sharp grey shard that bites sparks from steel and stone.

name: Wild Berries
description: Tart jungle berries, dark as dusk.

name: Plant Fiber
description: Tough green strands, good for lashing things together.

name: Broad Leaf
description: A wide leaf that sheds rain and catches sparks.

name: Stone Axe
description: A stone head lashed to a hardwood haft. Fells trees and bamboo far faster than bare hands.

name: Stone Pickaxe
description: A pointed stone on a stout haft, made for breaking boulders.

name: Spear
description: A bamboo shaft with a stone tip. Longer reach than bare hands — swing with Space, or click a creature.

name: Torch
description: Leaves and sticks bound into a flame. Burns only while held in the dark, about one night.

name: Campfire Kit
description: Stones and wood ready to be laid. Place it to cook and keep the dark back.

name: Bamboo Shelter Kit
description: Bamboo poles, fiber and thatch. Place it to sleep safely through the night.

name: Bamboo Shoot
nameKm: ទំពាំងឫស្សី
description: Bitter when raw. Barely a snack, and it upsets the stomach.

name: Roasted Bamboo Shoot
description: Sweet and smoky from the coals. A proper meal.

name: Raw Meat
description: Dark and heavy. Better over a fire than eaten as it is.

name: Cooked Meat
description: Smoky, filling, and still warm from the coals.

name: Hide
description: A rough pelt, stiff with drying mud.

name: Tiger Fang
description: Long, curved, and heavier than it looks.

name: Spirit Dust
description: Cold violet ash left where a night spirit faded. Fictional, and faintly glowing.

name: Raw Fish
description: A slippery river fish. Better cooked over a fire.

name: Grilled Fish
description: Fish grilled over the coals. Filling and gentle on the stomach.

name: Bamboo Fishing Rod
description: A springy bamboo pole with a fibre line. Hold it and press E at deep water.

name: Bamboo Tube
description: A hollow bamboo section with a node at the bottom. Hold it and press E at water to fill it.

name: Tube of River Water
description: River water to carry with you. Drinkable, but boiling it first is better.

name: Tube of Boiled Water
description: Water boiled over the fire. Clean, warm, and the base of soups and medicine.

name: Healing Leaf
description: A broad leaf with pale veins. Soothes cuts when bound into a dressing.

name: Bitter Root
description: A knobbly root under purple stems. Bitter, but it draws out venom when brewed.

name: Leaf Bandage
description: Healing leaves bound with plant fibre. Use (F) to treat wounds.

name: Bitter Root Brew
description: A strong, bitter brew in a bamboo tube. Use (F) to cure poison.

name: Jungle Stew
description: Bamboo shoots and berries simmered in boiled water. Eat it from the tube.

name: Fish and Leaf Soup
description: Fish and healing leaves in boiled water. Warming and restorative.

name: Cooking Pot
description: A clay pot with hearth stones. Place it (F) to brew soups and medicine.

name: Workbench
description: A sturdy bench for building walls, roofs, chests and beds. Place it (F).

name: Bamboo Wall
description: A lashed bamboo wall section. Place it (F); R rotates. Walls snap together.

name: Thatch Roof
description: A thatched roof on four posts. Keeps you and what is under it dry in the monsoon.

name: Storage Chest
description: A wooden chest with twelve slots. What you store stays safe, even far away.

name: Rain Collector
description: A leaf funnel over a bamboo vessel. Collects clean rainwater during the monsoon.

name: Bamboo Bed
description: A raised bed with a woven mat and a hide blanket. Sleeping here heals more and warms you fully.

name: Outpost Flag
description: Marks a camp as an outpost on your map. No new creatures appear near it. Up to 4 outposts, far apart.

name: Tube of Rainwater
description: Clean rainwater from a collector. Drink it as it is, or use it like boiled water.

name: Flint Axe
description: A keen flint head lashed with hide. Chops faster and lasts longer than stone.

name: Flint Pickaxe
description: A flint pick bound with hide. Breaks stone faster and lasts longer.

name: Fang Spear
description: A great fang bound to a bamboo shaft. Hits hard and reaches far.

name: Hide Vest
description: Cured hide stitched with fibre. Worn on the body: takes the edge off blows (-25% damage).

name: Leaf Rain Cape
description: Overlapping leaves woven on fibre. Worn on the body: you lose half as much warmth in the rain.

name: Bark Sandals
description: Bark soles with hide straps. Worn on the feet: walk 6% faster and mud and shallows slow you half as much.
